services.name: SportQuest SPA
services.description: Mobile-first, responsive SPA prototype for sports discovery, booking, community and gamification.
features: German-language interface and SportQuest branding with the slogan “Play. Connect. Level Up.”
Player profile with XP, streak tracking and daily check-in
Sports discovery and booking flows with interactive filters
Responsive, iOS-inspired mobile-first UI using #121826 and #cdf63d

questions.question: Which language should the SportQuest frontend use?

options.label: TypeScript
options.description: Typed JavaScript for stronger compile-time checks.

questions.rationale: The existing repository is a JavaScript React/Vite app.

questions.question: Which frontend framework and tooling should the prototype use?

options.label: React 19 with Vite
options.description: Continue with the framework and build tool already configured.

options.label: Other
options.description: Specify a different framework or toolchain.

questions.rationale: The repository already has React 19, Vite and the React Vite plugin configured.

questions.question: Which data stores does the prototype require?

options.label: No datastore required
options.description: Use seeded demo data and in-memory UI state only.

questions.rationale: This request is for an interactive frontend prototype without a backend or persistence.

questions.question: Should users sign in to use application API features?

options.label: Yes
options.description: Users authenticate to access application API features.

options.label: No
options.description: Keep the prototype open and use demo interactions without sign-in.

questions.rationale: No API or user sign-in flow is part of the requested prototype.
